meta_description: Buzz Electricians Leeds. Domestic and commercial electrical work, rewires, testing, emergency repairs. Fast, reliable service across West Yorkshire.
hero_subhead: Electrical fault at home or work? Buzz Electricians arrives quickly to diagnose and fix the problem, keeping you safe and connected.
services_heading: Electrical Services Across Leeds & West Yorkshire
services_subhead: From emergency repairs and testing to full rewires and new installations, we handle all domestic and commercial electrical work to the highest safety standards.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Power cut? Tripped electrics? Sparking socket? We diagnose and fix faults fast, any time of day. No call-out fee on the initial visit.

services.title: Domestic Rewires & Upgrades
services.desc: Old wiring putting your safety at risk? We strip out outdated electrics and install modern, compliant systems throughout your home, with full testing and certification.

services.title: Fusebox & Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Worn-out or inadequate fuseboxes are a fire hazard. We replace and upgrade to modern consumer units with RCD protection, tested and Part P certified.

services.title: Kitchen & Bathroom Installation
services.desc: New circuits for wet rooms and kitchen electrics, installed safely to Building Regulations. We handle sockets, lighting, and extractor fans.

services.title: PAT Testing & Electrical Safety Checks
services.desc: Landlords, businesses, and homeowners need proof of electrical safety. We carry out full inspections, testing, and certification to keep your property compliant.

services.title: EV Charging Point Installation
services.desc: Ready to go electric? We install home and workplace EV chargers, with all necessary electrical upgrades and certification included.

about_pullquote: We show up on time, we do the job right, and we charge fair prices. That's it.
about_para_1: Buzz Electricians has been serving Leeds and the surrounding areas for over 12 years. Founded on the principle that honesty and speed matter more than fancy marketing, we've built a reputation for turning up when we say we will, fixing the problem properly, and treating every customer's home or business with respect.
about_para_2: Our electricians are NICEIC approved and fully insured. We don't oversell work you don't need, and we always explain what's happening so you understand the issue and the fix. Word-of-mouth and repeat customers keep us busy — a sign that people trust us to get the job done right, first time.

reviews.text: Electrics went down on a Sunday afternoon — nightmare. Called Buzz and they were at the house in 45 minutes. Turned out to be the consumer unit. Fixed it there and then, fully tested, and didn't rip us off on the price. Absolute lifesaver. Will use them for everything from now on.
reviews.author: Tom H.

reviews.text: Had the whole house rewired by Buzz. They were professional, tidy, and kept us updated every step. The electricians explained everything so we knew what was being done and why. Took a week, all certified, and the electrical safety check gave us a clean bill of health. Couldn't be happier.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Kitchen needed new circuits and we were nervous about getting the wrong firm. Buzz came out, gave us a fair quote with no pressure, and the installation was flawless. They tidied up after themselves too, which was a bonus. Top quality electrician. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael P.

address_sub: Serving Leeds, Headingley, Chapel Allerton, Meanwood, and all surrounding areas of West Yorkshire.
emergency_banner_text: Electrical emergency in Leeds? We aim to be with you within the hour. Call now —
footer_description: Buzz Electricians is a trusted, local electrician in Leeds. NICEIC approved, fast response, fair prices, and expert domestic and commercial electrical work.
